scope: Two trials per configuration, each 100 fixed-seed self-play games, frozen final checkpoint, same deck and CPU settings, 24 total game engines. Fresh process per trial; all workers warmed before timing; startup excluded. No optimizer updates. Includes numerical trajectory writes. Trial order: single, replicated, replicated, single. Desktop background work and thermals not controlled.

single-a.scope: Warmed full self-play collection, including trajectory writing; startup excluded. Worker waits overlap and cannot be added to job wall time.
